description: Minimal role-based skill bootstrap index. Mandatory core skills per role (always loaded) + task-specific skills with trigger keywords (loaded on demand by dispatcher before packet construction). Companion to SKILL-BOOTSTRAP-DESIGN.md.

AHMAD.name: orchestration
AHMAD.description: Multi-agent dispatch coordination, task lifecycle, state tracking across running workers; knows the org role map and who owns what.

AHMAD.name: delegation
AHMAD.description: Writes task packets, selects implementer by boundary/availability, sets acceptance criteria, routes to review; writes the packet as a plain-text prompt handed to the harness/CLI (no formal task-packet-standard.md exists in this workspace).

AHMAD.name: recovery
AHMAD.description: Detects orphaned/zombie tasks and runs, performs P0/P1 reconciliation, wakes stalled dispatches, enforces re-entrancy guards on wake ticks.

HATTA.name: debugging
HATTA.description: Systematic root-cause debugging; reads errors, traces call paths, isolates defect class before patching; knows the org debug workflow.

HATTA.name: TDD
HATTA.description: Red-green-refactor discipline; writes failing test first, implements to pass, refactors; tests run as `node <file>.regression.test.mjs` using node:assert/strict + node:http mocks (no npm, no package.json, no :memory: DB in this workspace).

HATTA.name: verification
HATTA.description: Runs allowlisted build/test/seed commands, confirms green before claiming done; never modifies code to make a test pass.

GIBRAN.name: independent-review
GIBRAN.description: Reads a change against its acceptance criteria and role boundary; issues verdicts (approve/request-changes/block) with cited reasons; never self-approves.

GIBRAN.name: acceptance
GIBRAN.description: Judges whether a delivered artifact meets the stated acceptance criteria; distinguishes works from meets-spec.

GIBRAN.name: security
GIBRAN.description: Spots credential exposure, auth bypasses, destructive production actions, and safety-boundary violations in proposed changes; escalates to OWNER when found.

SJAHRIR.name: research
SJAHRIR.description: Gathers context from canonical sources, web, and prior session history; distinguishes verified vs stale vs unknown; does not infer from adjacent facts.

SJAHRIR.name: synthesis
SJAHRIR.description: Compresses heavy context into structured, caveman-friendly summaries; produces role maps, flow docs, and design drafts from raw research.

SJAHRIR.name: context-compression
SJAHRIR.description: Knows when to use compact summaries vs full detail; prevents context dilution on handoff; produces minimal-sufficient handoff text.

ESCALATION-SEC.name: owner-queue-steward
ESCALATION-SEC.description: Manages the WAITING_FOR_OWNER queue: triages items, surfaces them to OWNER at the right time; never fabricates owner decisions.

AUDIT-CLERK.name: consistency-audit
AUDIT-CLERK.description: Reads ledger and registry state, checks internal consistency, reports discrepancies; read-only, never writes.

TEST-RUNNER.name: test-execution
TEST-RUNNER.description: Runs specific allowlisted commands (in this workspace: `node <file>.regression.test.mjs`); reports output verbatim; never edits files.

MIGRATION-SURVEYOR.name: legacy-extraction
MIGRATION-SURVEYOR.description: Reads legacy system state and extracts structured snapshots; read-only, never mutates source systems.

GBRAIN-CURATOR.name: gbrain-ingestion
GBRAIN-CURATOR.description: Ingests documents/pages into the GBrain store per the ingestion contract; knows canonical source rules and what is source of truth.

RETRIEVAL-ASSISTANT.name: gbrain-query
RETRIEVAL-ASSISTANT.description: Runs pre-dispatch GBrain queries to surface relevant context before a task packet is built; read-only, never mutates GBrain.

GRAPHIFY-ANALYST.name: structural-analysis
GRAPHIFY-ANALYST.description: Answers structural and multi-hop code questions from current repo state; does not modify code.

OPS-WATCHER.name: deterministic-watch
OPS-WATCHER.description: Runs deterministic detectors only; no LLM calls, no inference; reports detector output verbatim.

PAPERCLIP-OPERATOR.name: paperclip-admin
PAPERCLIP-OPERATOR.description: Performs Paperclip administrative writes; every write is human-approved (OWNER or GIBRAN verdict) before execution; never auto-writes.

STEWARD-SJS.name: sj-snapshot
STEWARD-SJS.description: Produces SJS status snapshots from canonical sources; follows the status answer contract (PROJECT, STATE, CANONICAL SOURCE, LAST VERIFIED, WHAT CHANGED, ACTIVE TASKS, BLOCKERS, SAFETY, OWNER DECISION NEEDED).

STEWARD-CAVEMAN.name: caveman-watch
STEWARD-CAVEMAN.description: Reads Caveman trading state (read-only watch); reports state; does not trade, does not enable live trading.

TRADING-QUANT.name: trading-quant-analysis
TRADING-QUANT.description: Dormant by default; only loaded when an explicit task packet names TRADING-QUANT; performs quantitative analysis on trading data when invoked.

taskSpecific.name: paperclip-api-debugging
taskSpecific.description: Debugs Paperclip server API issues: connectivity, auth, endpoint behavior, error responses. Relevant when a task touches Paperclip server health or API contracts.

taskSpecific.name: telegram-bot-integration
taskSpecific.description: Integrates or debugs Telegram bot / Gateway connectivity: bot token, webhook, chat endpoint, message delivery. Relevant when a task touches the Telegram gateway or bot surface.

taskSpecific.name: regression-test-writing
taskSpecific.description: Writes regression tests for previously-fixed bugs or newly-covered scenarios. Relevant when a task touches test coverage, bug fixes that need a regression guard, or test gaps.

taskSpecific.name: gbrain-ingestion-run
taskSpecific.description: Runs a GBrain ingestion pass for a specific document set or source. Relevant when a task is explicitly about ingesting new material into GBrain (distinct from the GBRAIN-CURATOR's always-loaded core skill, which covers the ingestion contract itself).

taskSpecific.name: legacy-migration-query
taskSpecific.description: Runs read-only extraction queries against a legacy system as part of a migration survey. Relevant when a task touches legacy data extraction, schema discovery, or migration surveying.

taskSpecific.name: trading-quant-analysis
taskSpecific.description: Performs quantitative analysis on trading data (XAUUSD signals, strategy metrics, trade logs). Dormant — only loaded when TRADING-QUANT is explicitly named in a task packet. Not loaded for any other role.
